lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: The China Southern lounge is at the entrance to hall G in Terminal T3A. It is divided into areas for programme members and passengers in the two premium classes, with 187 seats in total. Facilities include luggage storage, a business area, a massage relaxation area, a mother-and-child room and showers.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: Holiday Inn Express Chongqing Airport Zone is at No.199 Lianggang Avenue in Yubei District. The hotel offers free breakfast and has Wi-Fi, parking and a restaurant. The minimum age for independent check-in is 18; check-out is by 12:00.
